recognize_zh: 淋巴球門內的 CD5 對 CD38 流式圖：淺藍色族群（推測為 CLL 的 B 細胞）CD5 弱陽性、CD38 表現分布很廣，有相當部分為 CD38 陽性；深紫色族群 CD5 較亮，推測為 T 細胞。CD38 陽性是 CLL 的不良預後指標，常見於 trisomy 12 的 CLL。
features: Lymphocyte-gated dot plot of CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD38-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Light blue population with dim CD5 (~10^3) and broad, heterogeneous CD38 expression spanning ~10^2 to 10^5
Substantial fraction of the light blue population is CD38-positive
Dark purple population with brighter CD5 (~5 x 10^3), presumed T cells
Few gray CD5-negative, CD38-bright events, likely plasma cells or other CD38-bright cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD5 versus CD38 on gated lymphocytes shows a dominant light blue population with dim CD5 and heterogeneous CD38 expression, a considerable portion of which is CD38-positive. A separate dark purple population with brighter CD5 is consistent with residual T cells. The exact percentage of CD38-positive cells cannot be determined from the plot alone and should be reported against the 30% threshold. Dim CD5 on the clonal B cells with a CD38-positive subset is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with CD38 expression, an adverse prognostic marker often seen with trisomy 12.

ddx.vs: MCL is CD5-positive with frequent CD38 expression, but is CD23-negative with brighter CD20/sIg and cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: Reactive B cells with CD38 upregulation
ddx.vs: Reactive or germinal center-derived B cells are CD5-negative and polytypic.
A T-cell neoplasm would show abnormal CD5 intensity or loss on CD3-positive cells rather than dim CD5 on CD19-positive B cells.
